name: CommuteHub
description:
CommuteHub connects Claude to your organization's commuter-benefits program, so you can manage your commute through conversation instead of switching apps.

Log & track trips — Record commutes by any mode, edit past entries, and review your recent trip history.

Plan your commute — Compare route and mode options for a trip, check the weather along the way, and look up locations.

Track rewards — Check your commute bonus balance and monthly stats, browse available incentives and perks, see challenge leaderboards, and check your points program status.

Manage parking — Check facility availability and view your permits and existing bookings.

Manage vehicles — Add, update, or remove vehicles on your commuter profile.

Get help — Search your employer's commute-program help center and knowledge base, check your open support tickets, or open a new one.

CommuteHub only works for user that already run RideAmigos CommuteHub with the AI assistant enabled. If you're not sure your company is set up, check with your commute program administrator. Your access is scoped to your own account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CommuteHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CommuteHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://central.rideamigos.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CommuteHub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CommuteHub lists 42 MCP tools, including add_user_vehicle, claim_incentive, create_post, create_support_ticket, delete_post, delete_user_vehicle, escalate_to_platform_admin, get_active_challenges, get_available_incentives, get_challenge_leaderboard, get_cms_content, and get_commute_bonus.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CommuteHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CommuteHub in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CommuteHub requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CommuteHub is developed by CommuteHub. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
